project_info.name: CarpetAdda
project_info.description: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level ultra-luxury Indian Real Estate Marketplace covering Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, and Kalyan-Dombivli.
project_info.art_direction: Dark Editorial Luxury meets Architectural Opulence (Deep Obsidian + Antique Champagne Gold + Sandstone Texture)
project_info.target_audience: HNIs, Luxury Property Buyers, Premium Renters, High-end Investors, Top Real Estate Developers & Elite Agents in MMR (Mumbai Metropolitan Region)

headings.description: High-contrast editorial serif for bold, architectural headlines that feel bespoke and timeless.

subheadings_and_accents.description: Uppercase, widely tracked, refined serif for badges, numbers, chapter labels, and architectural callouts.

body_and_ui.description: Ultra-clean geometric sans for high legibility in property metadata, filters, forms, and cards.

numbers_and_data.description: Precision monospace for carpet area (sq.ft), price per sq.ft, EMI breakdowns, and listing IDs.

font_size_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
font_size_hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug
font_size_hierarchy.manifesto_numeral: text-6xl sm:text-8xl font-serif text-amber-500/20 font-bold tracking-tighter
font_size_hierarchy.label_overline: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-amber-400/90 font-medium

gradients.card_spotlight: radial-gradient(600px circle at var(--mouse-x, 50%) var(--mouse-y, 50%), rgba(212,175,55,0.08), transparent 40%)

hero_animation.onload_reveal: Masked line-by-line stagger reveal with y-axis translate (y: 60 to 0) and blur reduction.
hero_animation.parallax_3d: Mouse move tilt + depth layer floating cards for 3D hero illusion.

implementation_rules_for_main_agent.file_structure_guidelines: Modify or create React components in src/pages/Home.jsx, src/components/Header.jsx, src/components/Footer.jsx, src/components/PropertyCard.jsx, src/components/SearchBar.jsx.
implementation_rules_for_main_agent.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive element (inputs, buttons, tabs, links, sliders, cards) MUST contain a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
implementation_rules_for_main_agent.contrast_and_accessibility: Always ensure high text contrast against dark backgrounds. Use text shadow or solid/semi-solid backdrop layers when overlaying text over images.
implementation_rules_for_main_agent.component_reuse: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Select, Dialog, Slider, Tabs, Accordion, Toast via sonner) while styling with Tailwind to match the dark luxury gold art direction.
implementation_rules_for_main_agent.motion_stack: Import motion from framer-motion for smooth entrance and hover effects. Use Lenis smooth scrolling initialized in App.js or Home.jsx.
